parsed.name: 2023A 射频信号发生器
parsed.description: 这是一台台式射频信号发生器，可在 9 千赫至 1.2 吉赫范围内输出可调的连续波射频信号，并支持频率、幅度、相位、输出开关和频率基准等设置。它常用于射频电路、接收机、通信设备和通用电子测试中的信号注入、校准与性能验证。
parsed.description_en: This is a benchtop RF signal generator that produces adjustable continuous-wave RF signals from 9 kHz to 1.2 GHz, with control of frequency, amplitude, phase, output enable, and frequency reference selection. It is commonly used for signal injection, calibration, and performance verification of RF circuits, receivers, communication equipment, and general electronic test setups.
